fact: The Minister of Communication, in charge of Posts and Telecommunications, drew on the Politique Nationale de Developpement des TIC at the WSIS Forum 2025 (Geneva, 7-11 July 2025) to report progress on the digital divide: broadband access infrastructure covering most of the territory, and two large sector projects (Djibouti Digital Foundations and the East Africa regional digital integration project) laying the base of a digital economy; the document is the ministry's own news item dated 2025-07-11 and gives no adoption date, period, costs or targets for the policy.
system: Politique nationale de développement des TIC

fact: The ministry page states that the Schéma Stratégique Intégré (SSI), the government roadmap that includes the National ICT Development Strategy, was adopted in 2014.
The page says the SSI was adopted in 2014 to develop the ICT sector over a period of 10 years, which ends in 2024.

The African Development Bank's country strategy paper, dated December 2022, refers to an existing integrated ICT Sector Strategic Plan (2014-2024) that aims to transform Djibouti into an information society hub (document published 2023-01-01; statement dated to the paper's December 2022 date).
The paper gives the integrated ICT Sector Strategic Plan a period of 2014 to 2024.
